units.source_text: 一日，朱雀院在寺旁的竹林里掘竹笋，又在附近山中掘些野芋，喜其有山乡风味，特派人送与三公主，并附一封详细的信。

en.t: One day, the Suzaku Retired Emperor dug bamboo shoots in the bamboo grove beside the temple, and also dug some wild yams in the nearby hills. Pleased by their rustic mountain flavor, he sent them specially to the Third Princess, along with a detailed letter.

units.source_text: 信的开头写道：“春日山野，烟霞迷路，只因对你思念不已，特地前往采掘，但亦聊表寸心而已。

en.t: The letter began: “In the hills and fields of spring, mist and haze make one lose the path; yet because my thoughts of you never cease, I went especially to gather these. Still, they are only a small token of my feelings.”
